# Budget controls page (`components/accounting/budgets/controls/`)

`/accounting/budgets/controls` (budgets P5-4, spec §5): the bill-approval budget check policy, alert thresholds (company default and per account or slice), the email digest switch, and the overspend alerts with Evaluate now and "last evaluated".

## Files
- `BudgetControlsPage.tsx`: role gating from `useCompany().companyRole` (write roles read; owner/admin edit and see alerts; a viewer gets a sentence). The server re-checks every role.
- `useBudgetControls.ts`: state + writes; a failed refresh keeps the last good data.
- `controlsClient.ts`: fetchers through the registry-typed `call` (`ApiResult`, never throws), `parseThresholds` (1-5 whole % in 1-999, sorted, deduped). Money via `formatMoney`, times via `formatDisplayDateTime` (SAST), as the type-and-money census requires.
- `PolicySettings.tsx`, `ThresholdOverrides.tsx`, `AlertsPanel.tsx` (table from md up, cards below for 390 px).

## Rules
- A save sends ONLY the changed fields (a stored email flag is never re-sent). The form follows the saved settings by value: a refresh with the same settings keeps unsaved edits; a change resets them.
- While the server's `BUDGET_ALERT_EMAIL_ENABLED` is not 1 (`emailAllowedOnServer`), the email checkbox says "Email sending is switched off on this server" and cannot be turned on (PUT 409 on false→true); one already on can be turned off.
- "Last evaluated" shows the daily run and Evaluate now separately; the warning (never, or older than 36 h) reads the DAILY run only (spec §10: the timer may not be installed).
- Threshold inputs are comma-separated text (`inputMode="text"`).
- A successful Evaluate now dispatches `isaflow:notifications-changed` (`@/lib/notificationsSignal`) so the header bell refetches its badge.
- Light and dark through the `--ff-*` variables. Browser proof: done by the coordinator (2026-11-03, `~/.cache/redchk/budgets-p5/p5-4/browser/`).
- Tests: `tests/unit/components/budgets/controls/{PolicySettings,AlertsPanel,useBudgetControlsSignal}.dom.test.tsx`.
